title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
summary: Meet GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI’s most capable model for business, with advanced reasoning, computer use, and stronger writing and design judgment.
title_es: OpenAI anuncia GPT-6 Astra para aplicaciones empresariales
bajada: OpenAI presenta GPT-6 Astra, su modelo más capaz para negocios, con razonamiento avanzado, capacidad de uso de computadora y mejor juicio en escritura y diseño. Este modelo representa un salto significativo en las capacidades de IA para tareas empresariales complejas.
bajada_en: OpenAI unveils GPT-6 Astra, its most capable model for business, featuring advanced reasoning, computer use abilities, and improved writing and design judgment. This model represents a significant leap in AI capabilities for complex business tasks.

title: Now everyone can put data to work
summary: Meet the Data agent in ChatGPT Work. Connect company data, uncover insights, and build interactive dashboards with AI using natural language.
title_es: OpenAI lanza Data agent para ChatGPT Work
bajada: OpenAI presenta un agente de datos en ChatGPT Work que permite conectar datos empresariales y crear dashboards interactivos usando lenguaje natural. La herramienta busca democratizar el acceso a análisis de datos sin requerir conocimientos técnicos avanzados.
bajada_en: OpenAI introduces a Data agent in ChatGPT Work that enables connecting company data and creating interactive dashboards using natural language. The tool aims to democratize data analysis access without requiring advanced technical knowledge.

title: Universal Music is launching an AI music platform with ElevenLabs
summary: Universal Music Group is launching a new AI-powered platform that will allow users to draw from its catalog of licensed music to create song remixes, mashups, and new takes on tracks, according to an announcement on Thursday. The record label is developing the platform through a multi-year licensing agreement with ElevenLabs, a company that specializes […]
title_es: Universal Music y ElevenLabs lanzan plataforma de música IA
bajada: Universal Music Group desarrolla una plataforma de IA con ElevenLabs que permite crear remixes y mashups a partir de su catálogo licenciado. El acuerdo multianual marca un importante paso en la integración de IA en la industria musical con consentimiento de derechos de autor.
bajada_en: Universal Music Group launches an AI platform with ElevenLabs enabling users to create remixes and mashups from its licensed catalog. The multi-year deal marks a significant step in AI integration within the music industry with copyright consent.

title: Expanding AI access and cyber defense for federal, state, local, and tribal governments
summary: OpenAI and GSA will offer eligible federal, state, local, and tribal governments $0 license fees, 50% off usage, and expanded cyber defense support.
title_es: OpenAI ofrece acceso gratuito a gobiernos estadounidenses
bajada: OpenAI y GSA acuerdan ofrecer a gobiernos federales, estatales, locales e indígenas licencias sin costo y 50% de descuento en uso, además de soporte mejorado en defensa cibernética. La iniciativa busca expandir el acceso a IA en el sector público.
bajada_en: OpenAI and GSA agree to offer eligible US governments zero license fees, 50% usage discounts, and enhanced cyber defense support. The initiative aims to expand AI access in the public sector.

title: Meta’s Muse AI works and creeps me out
summary: Meta has launched its new Muse assistant, marking the company's first real foray into AI-powered productivity tools. The company says its AI agent can "take the busywork off your plate" by helping you with online shopping, emails, trip-planning, and more. I decided to try out the new tool and see how well it performed - […]
title_es: Meta presenta Muse, su nuevo asistente de productividad
bajada: Meta lanza Muse, su primer asistente de IA para tareas de productividad, capaz de ayudar en compras, emails, planificación de viajes y más. La herramienta representa la entrada formal de Meta en el mercado de agentes de IA empresariales.
bajada_en: Meta launches Muse, its first AI productivity assistant capable of helping with shopping, emails, trip planning, and more. The tool marks Meta's formal entry into the AI agent market for business tasks.

title: AI research startup Listen Labs scrubbed a $1.5B funding round for Salesforce talks
summary: Listen Labs walked away from a signed Series C term sheet from Menlo Ventures, sources say.
title_es: Listen Labs abandona ronda de $1.5B para hablar con Salesforce
bajada: La startup de investigación en IA Listen Labs canceló una ronda Serie C firmada con Menlo Ventures para explorar conversaciones con Salesforce. El movimiento sugiere un posible acuerdo o inversión de mayor envergadura con la compañía de software empresarial.
bajada_en: AI research startup Listen Labs scrapped a signed Series C funding round with Menlo Ventures to pursue talks with Salesforce. The move suggests a potential larger deal or investment opportunity with the enterprise software company.

title: Maven Robotics wants to steal your robot deployment deal
summary: Maven Robotics emerged from stealth today with a $100 million Series A and active deployments.
title_es: Maven Robotics sale de sigilo con $100M y despliegues activos
bajada: Maven Robotics emerge del sigilo con una ronda Serie A de $100 millones y ya tiene despliegues activos en clientes. La empresa busca capturar oportunidades en el mercado de automatización robótica acelerado por IA.
bajada_en: Maven Robotics emerges from stealth with a $100 million Series A and active customer deployments. The company aims to capture opportunities in the AI-accelerated robotics automation market.

title: Mathematicians want proof OpenAI didn’t use their work
summary: Another researcher is challenging OpenAI about the data driving its increasingly impressive array of mathematical discoveries. Just days after a bitter row erupted over whether the company's models benefited from unpublished work, a second mathematician has come forward accusing the AI giant of unethical and "dishonest" behavior and a lack of transparency about the origins […]
title_es: Matemáticos cuestionan a OpenAI sobre uso de investigaciones
bajada: Un segundo matemático acusa a OpenAI de falta de transparencia sobre el origen de sus datos de entrenamiento para descubrimientos matemáticos. La denuncia se suma a controversias recientes sobre si OpenAI utilizó investigación no publicada en sus modelos.
bajada_en: A second mathematician accuses OpenAI of lacking transparency about training data origins for mathematical discoveries. The allegation adds to recent controversies about whether OpenAI used unpublished research in its models.

title: Suno releases its first AI music model made with record industry help
summary: Suno's new v6 AI music model is its first made with support from the record industry. Suno's Jack Brody told The Verge that v6 was "trained from the ground up, with a new set of data that does not include the same data that our previous models were trained on." The data includes content licensed […]
title_es: Suno lanza v6, su primer modelo con apoyo de la industria
bajada: Suno presenta su modelo v6 de música IA entrenado con apoyo de la industria discográfica usando datos con licencia. El modelo marca un cambio importante hacia IA musical desarrollada con consentimiento de derechos de autor.
bajada_en: Suno releases v6, its first AI music model trained with record industry support using licensed data. The model marks a significant shift toward AI music development with copyright consent.

title: Clearview AI Is Testing an AI Tool That Would Let Cops Unearth Your Life Online
summary: InquiryIQ, a previously unreported prototype, tested a model from xAI, maker of Grok, to surface associates, social accounts, and other information about people identified through Clearview.
title_es: Clearview AI prueba herramienta de vigilancia policial con xAI
bajada: Clearview AI desarrolla InquiryIQ, un prototipo que utiliza el modelo Grok de xAI para que policías rastreen información personal, asociados y cuentas de redes sociales de personas. La herramienta plantea serias preocupaciones sobre privacidad y vigilancia masiva.
bajada_en: Clearview AI develops InquiryIQ, a prototype using xAI's Grok model to help police track personal information, associates, and social accounts of individuals. The tool raises serious privacy and mass surveillance concerns.

title: d-Matrix Adopts NVIDIA NVLink Fusion for Rack-Scale XPU Deployment
summary: AI inference chipmaker d-Matrix today announced it will use NVIDIA NVLink Fusion to connect its next-generation Raptor XPUs to NVIDIA’s AI infrastructure platform — joining a growing roster of ecosystem partners. By connecting Raptor to NVIDIA NVLink scale-up and Spectrum-X scale-out networking, the NVIDIA MGX rack architecture and the broader NVIDIA AI platform, NVLink Fusion […]
title_es: d-Matrix adopta NVIDIA NVLink para infraestructura de IA
bajada: El fabricante de chips d-Matrix anunciará el uso de NVIDIA NVLink Fusion para conectar sus XPUs Raptor a la plataforma de infraestructura de IA de NVIDIA. La integración amplía el ecosistema de partners y las opciones de escalabilidad para inferencia.
bajada_en: AI chipmaker d-Matrix announces adoption of NVIDIA NVLink Fusion to connect its Raptor XPUs to NVIDIA's AI infrastructure platform. The integration expands the partner ecosystem and scalability options for inference.

title: The AI policy window is open. We need to act.
summary: Chris Lehane argues that stronger AI capabilities require stronger safety evidence, shared standards, and durable policy action while the policy window remains open.
title_es: OpenAI aboga por regulación de IA mientras haya oportunidad
bajada: Chris Lehane argumenta que capacidades de IA más fuertes requieren evidencia de seguridad más sólida, estándares compartidos y políticas duraderas. El documento enfatiza la importancia de actuar en el actual contexto político favorable para la regulación.
bajada_en: Chris Lehane argues that stronger AI capabilities require stronger safety evidence, shared standards, and durable policy action. The piece emphasizes the importance of acting while the political window for regulation remains open.

title: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI Foundation Board
summary: Paul Christiano joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee, bringing experience in AI alignment, safety, and standards.
title_es: Paul Christiano se une a la Junta de la Fundación OpenAI
bajada: Paul Christiano, experto en alineación y seguridad de IA, se incorpora a la Junta de la Fundación OpenAI y su Comité de Seguridad. El nombramiento refuerza el enfoque de la organización en estándares de seguridad y alineación.
bajada_en: Paul Christiano, expert in AI alignment and safety, joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and Safety and Security Committee. The appointment strengthens the organization's focus on safety standards and alignment.

title: Rebuilding AUTOMATIC1111 with Gradio Workflow
title_es: Hugging Face reconstruye AUTOMATIC1111 con Gradio Workflow
bajada: Hugging Face presenta una reconstrucción de la popular herramienta AUTOMATIC1111 usando Gradio Workflow, mejorando accesibilidad y funcionalidad. La iniciativa facilita a developers crear pipelines de generación de imágenes sin código complejo.
bajada_en: Hugging Face rebuilds the popular AUTOMATIC1111 tool using Gradio Workflow, improving accessibility and functionality. The initiative makes it easier for developers to create image generation pipelines without complex coding.

title: IBM releases SOTA Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2 model with commercial-friendly license
title_es: IBM lanza modelo Granite Time Series con licencia comercial
bajada: IBM Research publica Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2, un modelo de última generación para series temporales con licencia comercial favorable. El modelo está disponible en Hugging Face y permite a developers entrenar sobre datos históricos con libertad comercial.
bajada_en: IBM Research releases Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2, a state-of-the-art time series model with commercial-friendly licensing. The model is available on Hugging Face and allows developers to train on historical data with commercial freedom.

title: Introducing the Agents API
summary: Build and launch cloud agents with the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness for orchestration, long-running sessions, and tool use.
title_es: OpenAI lanza Agents API para construir agentes en la nube
bajada: OpenAI presentó su Agents API, un servicio gestionado que permite crear y desplegar agentes de IA con sesiones de larga duración y capacidad de usar herramientas. Esta es una herramienta clave para developers que quieran construir aplicaciones agentic sin gestionar la infraestructura subyacente.
bajada_en: OpenAI unveiled its Agents API, a managed service for building and deploying AI agents with long-running sessions and tool use capabilities. This is a key offering for developers looking to build agentic applications without managing underlying infrastructure.

title: Skild AI Taps NVIDIA Physical AI to Teach Robots New Tasks From a Single Video
summary: Manufacturing floors, warehouses and production lines rarely stay fixed — tasks change, layouts shift and new products arrive, and most robots can’t keep up without significant reprogramming. Skild AI’s new S1 robot foundation model helps address this, designed to learn previously unseen, long-horizon tasks from a single video demonstration. The model, launched last week, uses […]
title_es: Skild AI crea robot que aprende tareas nuevas de un video
bajada: Skild AI lanzó su modelo S1, un foundation model para robots que puede aprender tareas complejas nunca vistas a partir de una única demostración en video. Esta capacidad es crucial para manufactureras y almacenes donde las tareas cambian constantemente sin necesidad de reprogramación manual.
bajada_en: Skild AI launched its S1 model, a robot foundation model that can learn previously unseen complex tasks from a single video demonstration. This capability is crucial for manufacturing and warehousing environments where tasks change frequently without manual reprogramming.

title: Anthropic details distillation campaigns from Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek
summary: A new report released Thursday by Anthropic alleges persistent distillation attacks by China-based AI companies, which have escalated in recent months as competition in the space has intensified.
title_es: Anthropic reporta ataques de destilación de empresas chinas
bajada: Anthropic publicó un reporte documentando intentos persistentes de destilación de modelos por parte de empresas chinas como Alibaba, Moonshot AI y DeepSeek. Los ataques han intensificado con la competencia creciente en el mercado de IA, planteando preocupaciones sobre seguridad de modelos.
bajada_en: Anthropic released a report documenting persistent model distillation attempts by Chinese AI companies including Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek. Attacks have escalated with growing competition in the AI market, raising concerns about model security.

title: Anthropic Says It Blocked Bioweapons Efforts and Detected Chinese Distillation Attacks
summary: Anthropic has disrupted severalattempts to use its Claude models for potentially malicious activity, including research into how to adapt bird flu to a human-transmittable strain with “pandemic potential,” the company said in a report Thursday.Amid increasing worry about AI misuse androgue ...
title_es: Anthropic bloqueó intentos de crear bioarmas con Claude
bajada: Anthropic reportó haber interrumpido varios intentos de usar Claude para actividades potencialmente maliciosas, incluyendo investigación sobre adaptar la gripe aviar para transmisión humana. El reporte subraya los desafíos crecientes en mitigación de riesgos de bioseguridad en modelos de IA.
bajada_en: Anthropic reported disrupting multiple attempts to use Claude for potentially malicious activities, including research to adapt bird flu for human transmission. The report highlights growing challenges in biosecurity risk mitigation for AI models.

title: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services
summary: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services, combining built-in financial data and GPT-6 Astra for research, modeling, and client-ready materials.
title_es: OpenAI presenta ChatGPT para servicios financieros
bajada: OpenAI lanzó una versión especializada de ChatGPT con datos financieros integrados y GPT-6 Astra, diseñada para investigación, modelado y generación de reportes listos para clientes. Esta solución vertical muestra el movimiento de OpenAI hacia verticales específicas de negocio.
bajada_en: OpenAI launched a specialized ChatGPT version with built-in financial data and GPT-6 Astra, designed for research, modeling, and client-ready report generation. This vertical solution shows OpenAI's push toward specific business verticals.

title: How a researcher uses Codex and ChatGPT to search for new antimicrobial molecules
summary: César de la Fuente’s lab uses Codex and ChatGPT to search living and extinct genomes for antimicrobial candidates to fight drug-resistant infections.
title_es: IA acelera búsqueda de moléculas antimicrobianas contra infecciones resistentes
bajada: Un laboratorio de investigación usa Codex y ChatGPT para buscar en genomas de organismos vivos y extintos candidatos antimicrobianos contra infecciones resistentes a medicamentos. Este caso demuestra el impacto real de la IA en investigación científica aplicada.
bajada_en: A research lab uses Codex and ChatGPT to search living and extinct genomes for antimicrobial candidates against drug-resistant infections. This case demonstrates real-world impact of AI in applied scientific research.

title: Slack can now vibe-code interactive charts and reports inside chats
summary: A new feature coming to Slack will allow you to build interactive reports, polls, dashboards, presentations, microsites, and other tools directly inside a chat. With Slackforce Surfaces, you can describe to Slackbot what you need, and it will use AI to gather information from relevant conversations and connected apps, like Google Drive or Salesforce, to […]
title_es: Slack integra generación de reportes interactivos con IA
bajada: Slack lanzó Slackforce Surfaces, que permite crear reportes, dashboards y presentaciones interactivas directamente en chats describiendo necesidades a Slackbot. La IA recopila información de conversaciones e integraciones como Google Drive y Salesforce, mejorando productividad de equipo.
bajada_en: Slack launched Slackforce Surfaces, enabling creation of interactive reports, dashboards, and presentations directly in chats by describing needs to Slackbot. AI gathers information from conversations and integrations like Google Drive and Salesforce, improving team productivity.

title: Physical AI Takes the Wheel: How the World’s Robotaxi Leaders Are Building With NVIDIA Technologies
summary: The global robotaxi market — physical AI’s first commercial breakthrough — is projected to reach $400 billion by 2035, with over 6 million commercial vehicles in operation as driverless fleets are already moving people through some of the world’s busiest and most complex streets. Deploying a driverless vehicle is one challenge. Scaling a fleet is […]
title_es: Robotaxis avanzan hacia mercado de $400 mil millones para 2035
bajada: NVIDIA analiza cómo líderes de robotaxis están construyendo sobre su stack de tecnologías, con el mercado proyectado a alcanzar $400 mil millones y 6 millones de vehículos comerciales para 2035. El Physical AI es el primer gran éxito comercial de la IA aplicada.
bajada_en: NVIDIA analyzes how robotaxi leaders are building on its technology stack, with the market projected to reach $400 billion and 6 million commercial vehicles by 2035. Physical AI represents the first major commercial breakthrough for applied AI.

title: OpenAI puts Pro subscriptions on hold due to Astra demand
summary: The company said Pro subscriptions put the most strain on its systems, so it's pausing sign-ups while adding more capacity.
title_es: OpenAI pausa suscripciones Pro por demanda de Astra
bajada: OpenAI pausó temporalmente nuevas suscripciones Pro mientras aumenta capacidad de infraestructura debido a la alta demanda de su modelo Astra. El movimiento refleja desafíos operacionales que enfrentan los providers de IA ante crecimiento acelerado de usuarios.
bajada_en: OpenAI temporarily paused new Pro subscriptions while scaling infrastructure capacity due to high Astra model demand. The move reflects operational challenges AI providers face amid accelerated user growth.

title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now the No. 2 app in the US
summary: Meta's newest app Muse is off to a slower start than the company's other apps, like Meta AI or Threads.
title_es: Agente Muse de Meta alcanza posición No. 2 en apps de EE.UU.
bajada: El nuevo agente Muse de Meta se posicionó como la segunda app más descargada en Estados Unidos, aunque con un crecimiento más lento que otros productos de Meta como Meta AI o Threads. El resultado muestra la competencia intensa en el mercado de agentes IA.
bajada_en: Meta's new Muse agent became the second most downloaded app in the US, though with slower growth than other Meta products like Meta AI or Threads. The result shows intense competition in the AI agents market.

title: Jensen Huang explains why Nvidia will grow an astounding 70% next year
summary: Nvidia has its finger in every pie, and sees another year of plenty in its future, Jensen Huang says. But, he insists, its deals are not circular.
title_es: Jensen Huang predice crecimiento de 70% para NVIDIA
bajada: El CEO de NVIDIA, Jensen Huang, proyectó que la empresa crecerá 70% el próximo año, atribuyendo el crecimiento a su posición diversificada en infraestructura de IA. Aunque Huang negó que sus tratos sean circulares, el pronóstico refleja la demanda sostenida por hardware de IA.
bajada_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang projected 70% growth for next year, attributing it to the company's diversified position in AI infrastructure. While Huang denied circular dealings, the forecast reflects sustained demand for AI hardware.

title: Adobe Shares Drop 2% Despite AI Product Sales Growth
summary: Adobe Systems shares dipped 2% late Thursday after its third-quarter earnings report, as some investors appear to unsure about how much its AI products will drive future revenue growth.Adobe, which began breaking out revenue for its AI products in March, is continuing to highlight this area of ...
title_es: Acciones de Adobe caen 2% a pesar del crecimiento en ventas de IA
bajada: Las acciones de Adobe bajaron 2% después de reportar resultados Q3, con inversores mostrando cautela sobre cómo sus productos de IA impulsarán crecimiento futuro. Adobe comenzó a desglosar ingresos de IA en marzo, señalando la importancia creciente de este segmento.
bajada_en: Adobe shares dropped 2% after Q3 results, with investors showing caution about how AI products will drive future growth. Adobe began breaking out AI revenue in March, signaling the growing importance of this segment.

title: Schools are catching on to Big Tech’s playbook
summary: It's the hot new thing in tech, and it's where all the jobs are. Students who don't learn to use it fall behind. And to help them catch up in time, its creators are graciously providing the resources and curriculum for learning it, often pro bono. That's the narrative AI companies are pitching schools on […]
title_es: Escuelas detectan estrategia de Big Tech para adopción de IA
bajada: Escuelas reconocen que compañías tech promocionan IA como habilidad esencial mientras proporcionan currículos y recursos gratuitos para adopción. El modelo replica estrategias históricas de tech en educación, generando dependencia de sus plataformas desde temprana edad.
bajada_en: Schools recognize that tech companies promote AI as essential skill while providing free curricula and resources for adoption. The model mirrors historical tech strategies in education, creating platform dependency from early ages.

title: Fund Focused on Bootstrapped Founders Raises $950 Million
summary: There’s certainly a frenzy among venture capitalists to back the hottest startups before they’ve made a dime of revenue, but one fund is sticking to a proven strategy of investing in startups that have generated at least millions in revenue—often without raising any institutional money.Focusing on these boot-strapped founders hasagain resonatedwith Volition Capital’s limited partners. The Boston-based growth equity firm, which cut its teeth investing in consumer startups like Chewy and enterprise software companies, raised $950 million for its sixth fund, co-founder Larry Cheng told The Information exclusively. The fundraise, Volition’s largest, brings the 16-year-old firm’s assets under management to $2.6 billion.
title_es: Fondo enfocado en founders bootstrapped recauda $950 millones
bajada: Volition Capital recaudó $950 millones para su sexto fondo, enfocándose en startups que ya generan millones en ingresos sin capital institucional. El crecimiento del fondo a $2.6 mil millones AUM refleja el interés creciente en modelos de negocio sustentables.
bajada_en: Volition Capital raised $950 million for its sixth fund, focusing on startups already generating millions in revenue without institutional capital. The fund's growth to $2.6 billion AUM reflects growing interest in sustainable business models.

title: 3 ways to prep for your next big race with Search
summary: Illustration on a blue background of technicolor runners with a magnifying glass and Gemini spark overlaid
title_es: Google potencia búsqueda para entrenamiento de corredores
bajada: Google mejoró su Search y Gemini para ayudar corredores en preparación de carreras con tips de entrenamiento optimizados. La actualización es un ejemplo menor de integración de IA en funcionalidades cotidianas de búsqueda.
bajada_en: Google enhanced its Search and Gemini to help runners prepare for races with optimized training tips. The update is a minor example of AI integration into everyday search functionality.
